title: Hybrid Control of ADT Switched Linear Systems subject to Actuator Saturation
summary: This paper develops a hybrid output-feedback control framework for average dwell-time (ADT) switched linear systems subject to actuator saturation. The considered subsystems may be exponentially unstable, and the saturation nonlinearity is explicitly handled through a deadzone-based representation. The proposed hybrid controller combines mode-dependent full-order dynamic output-feedback controllers with a supervisory reset mechanism that updates controller states at switching instants.
